items.source: Manipulate this response's headers with the given consumer. The headers provided to the consumer are "live", so that the consumer can be used to overwrite existing header values, remove values, or use any of the other HttpHeaders methods.

items.source: Manipulate this response's cookies with the given consumer. The cookies provided to the consumer are "live", so that the consumer can be used to overwrite existing cookies, remove cookies, or use any of the other MultiValueMap methods.

items.source:
Configure one or more request header names (for example, "Accept-Language") to
add to the "Vary" response header to inform clients that the response is
subject to content negotiation and variances based on the value of the
given request headers.
items.translation: 配置一个或多个请求头名称（例如，"Accept-Language"），将其添加到"Vary"响应头中，以告知客户端响应受内容协商影响，且会根据给定请求头的值而变化。

items.source:
Configure one or more request header names (for example, "Accept-Language") to
add to the "Vary" response header to inform clients that the response is
subject to content negotiation and variances based on the value of the
given request headers. The configured request header names are added only
if not already present in the response "Vary" header.
items.translation: 配置一个或多个请求头名称（例如，"Accept-Language"），将其添加到响应头"Vary"中，以告知客户端响应受内容协商影响，且会根据给定请求头的值而变化。如果响应头"Vary"中尚未存在这些配置的请求头名称，则仅添加它们。
